description: Implementation of WebSocket deflate stream handling, including compression and decompression of WebSocket frames, with support for deflate parameters, predictor, and stream management.

classes.name: WebSocketDeflateStream
classes.description: Handles WebSocket frame compression and decompression with deflate, managing stream state, deflate parameters, and predictor for deflate decisions.

methods.name: ReadFrames
methods.description: Reads WebSocket frames from the stream, inflates if necessary, and handles callback upon completion.

methods.name: WriteFrames
methods.description: Deflates frames if applicable and writes them to the stream.

methods.name: OnReadComplete
methods.description: Callback invoked after read operation completes, triggers inflation if needed.

methods.name: Deflate
methods.description: Compresses frames using deflater and prepares them for sending.

methods.name: OnMessageStart
methods.description: Determines whether to deflate or not based on predictor prediction at message start.

methods.name: AppendCompressedFrame
methods.description: Creates a compressed frame from deflater output and appends to frames to send.

methods.name: AppendPossiblyCompressedMessage
methods.description: Handles frames that may or may not be compressed based on effectiveness.

methods.name: Inflate
methods.description: Decompresses frames using inflater, generating inflated frames.

methods.name: InflateAndReadIfNecessary
methods.description: Performs inflation and reads more frames if needed until complete.
